gaps.sentence: He ordered ___ steak, but it arrived cold.
gaps.explanation: 'A steak' first, then 'the waiter' — the restaurant's waiter, definite in context.

gaps.sentence: He behaves as if he were ___ owner of the company.
gaps.explanation: 'The owner' — there is one owner, so 'the'.

gaps.sentence: ___ sun sets much later in summer.
gaps.explanation: 'The sun' — there is only one, so the definite article is used.

gaps.sentence: She was elected ___ president of the students' union.
gaps.explanation: After 'elect/appoint/make + role', the article is usually dropped: elected president.

gaps.sentence: We had ___ wonderful time in Prague.
gaps.explanation: 'Have a wonderful/great/good time' — 'time' here is countable and takes 'a'.

gaps.sentence: We bought ___ antique mirror at the flea market.
gaps.explanation: 'An antique mirror' — 'antique' starts with a vowel sound.

gaps.sentence: He found ___ coin buried in the sand.
gaps.explanation: 'A coin' first mention; 'in the sand' — sand as a mass takes 'the' here (the sand on that beach).

gaps.sentence: She did her doctorate at ___ University of Oxford.
